subject: Inside Real AI Software Factories: Automating from Planning to Production
body:
Hello First Name,

This week's 🦄 ai that works session took us deep inside real AI software factories, exploring how they automate everything from planning to production!

Good news! You can now find the full recording, code, and diagrams from the session on GitHub:
https://github.com/hellovai/ai-that-works

We talked a lot about building and scaling AI-powered software, with practical insights from people actually doing it. Here are a few key takeaways:

*   **The "Discuss-Do-Compound" Loop for Hyper-Growth**: We looked at this loop, which showed us how a small team grew a HIPAA-compliant chat app from $270K to $400K ARR in just three months. They did this using a smart three-phase system: planning out tasks clearly, letting AI agents handle the execution, and then having humans review and continuously improve the AI's process.
*   **Orchestrators as the New Management Frontier**: We also explored this concept. Imagine an "orchestrator chat" that can manage several AI agents at once. It takes insights and issues, turns them into actionable tickets, and even lets agents create pull requests for small tasks on their own. The goal is a "Tinder-style" interface where humans can quickly review and approve.
*   **The Dev Environment is the Hardest Part**: Turns out, for bigger companies, getting cloud agents set up is tough. The main challenge is building a dev environment that's consistent, easy for agents to use, handles all those tricky internal dependencies and authentication, and allows for quick testing and feedback.

If there's one big takeaway from this session, it's this: Building a truly effective AI software factory is all about smart process engineering. You need to constantly find and fix bottlenecks, design strong feedback loops, and make sure your system works well for both AI agents and all the different people on your team.

Got questions? Just reply to this email or hop into our Discord: https://www.boundaryml.com/discord. We genuinely love hearing from you and read every message! Happy coding 🧑‍💻

Vaibhav & Dex
